title: Print Reports — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: One report in the Print Reports list. Each company is given the standard list when it is created; a report you rename, switch off or delete is left as you set it. A report can be run only if the product has that report built in — otherwise it is listed but cannot be run.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: ReportName
fields.html:
What it is. The name of the built-in report this entry runs.

Why it matters. Must match a built-in report exactly, or the entry cannot be run. Change it only to point at another built-in report.

fields.label: ReportCategory
fields.html:
What it is. Whether this is a standard or a custom report.

Why it matters. Shown as a column in the Print Reports list; it changes nothing else.

fields.label: CustomPercentage
fields.html:
What it is. How far the report has been customised, as a percentage.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: ReportCreatedOn
fields.html:
What it is. When the report was made.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: IsActive
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the report is listed.

Why it matters. Unticked reports are left out of the Print Reports list for everyone.
